newsitem.title: CHINA: China reduces quarantine checks with Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: China reduces quarantine checks with Hong Kong.

text.p: China simplified border formalities between its Shenzhen Special Economic Zone and Hong Kong on Thursday by withdrawing animal and plant quarantine departments, the Xinhua news agency said.
From Thursday, drivers passing through the ports of entry at Shenzhen will not have to stop for the series of four checks that were previously in force, it said.
Instead, they will fill in declaration forms for their vehicles and goods before exit and entry.

Cargoes of plants and vegetables will be required to pass a check before reaching the border while the animal quarantine departments will increase checks at port of entry areas and cargo destinations, it said.
Shenzhen has three land ports of entry, handling more than eight million vehicles annually and accounting for 70 percent of China's total land trade.
Most of Hong Kong's vegetables are brought across the border from China.
